description: No clean concept found. The strongest firing often occurs mid-game when column 4 is exactly four high with my stone on top at row 3 (landing cell (4,4) still empty), frequently with my stones stacked or paired at the centre on row 3 and the opponent's row-1 stones beneath; the opponent covering column 4 switches it off. But this covers only a small part of firing, and many early openings also fire irregularly.
effect: Weak: when forced high it lowers the model's favoured centre column (3 or 4) by about 2-13 points and spreads probability to flank columns; zeroing it raises columns 3/4 by about 3-6 points.
notes: 5 dev calls. Best: col4 height 4 with my stone at (3,4): F1 0.13, AUROC 0.56, sim share 0.01. Generalisations (top of col4 mine; empty column; last move col 3/6; specific O-X-X stack) all gave AUROC 0.51-0.55. Activation is highly context dependent (alternates with whose turn it is, decays as board fills with little board change); top examples cluster in few games. Likely a mixture or random direction. Synthesis reaches 8.51 > dev max 7.70.
